hooks.command: for p in python python3 py; do if command -v "$p" >/dev/null 2>&1; then "$p" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/userdata.py" apply && exit 0; fi; done; exit 0
for p in python python3 py; do if command -v "$p" >/dev/null 2>&1; then "$p" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/userdata.py" save && exit 0; fi; done; exit 0
